key_insight: Reasoning-guided translation can preserve benchmark meaning across languages, enabling more reliable multilingual safety and mathematical reasoning evaluation than direct translation alone.
engineering_relevance: This framework provides a scalable way to build high-quality multilingual test sets for evaluating LLM behavior in safety-critical and reasoning-heavy applications beyond English.
method: Select translation strategies with reasoning guidance before generation
Apply task-aware validation, targeted repair, and independent quality screening
Assemble source-aligned benchmarks across safety, conversation, and math resources in 11 languages
evidence_signal: The resulting collection covers 99.94% of intended item–language pairs in the two subsets that required repair, and evaluations show language-dependent refusal inconsistencies and reasoning drops in lower-resource languages.
watch_item: Benchmark quality still depends on preserving task intent during translation, so low-resource languages and culturally sensitive harmful prompts may remain harder to validate consistently.
paper_title: Scaling Multilingual Safety and Reasoning Evaluation through Reasoning-Guided Translation
